orchestrator.purpose: Maintain compact strategic state across long-running work and spawn bounded workers for concrete attempts.

integration.work_contract: WORK_CONTRACT.json remains the canonical worker handoff surface.
integration.dispatcher: valo-orchestrator remains the canonical control process for factory dispatch.
integration.qc: Independent QC evaluates returned work; worker success claims are not accepted as proof.
integration.execution_boundary: Consequence-bearing actions remain subject to fresh VAIG -> REHT -> RACS binding before execution.
integration.receipts: Observed results and boundary decisions are recorded as evidence/receipts; orchestration state is not a permit.

required_invariants: The orchestrator coordinates work but never grants execution authority.
Worker transcripts are disposable context, not canonical state.
Only compact strategic state and evidence references survive worker turnover.
A worker may fail, restart or be replaced without changing authority state.
Workers cannot validate their own output as correct.
Provider/model swaps must not change governance semantics.
REHT remains the sole final authorization boundary for consequence-bearing execution.
